Implemented FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_Task (CODESYS 3.5 ST) for the guarded motor latch and compiled it successfully on the first attempt — 0 errors, 0 warnings.

Interface (exact): inputs Start, Stop, GuardClosed : BOOL; output Run : BOOL. Internal state: qRun (retained run, init FALSE) and first (init TRUE).

Body:
```
IF first THEN
    qRun := FALSE;
    first := FALSE;
END_IF

IF Stop OR NOT GuardClosed THEN
    Run := FALSE;
ELSIF Start THEN
    Run := TRUE;
ELSE
    Run := qRun;
END_IF

qRun := Run;
```

Behavior verification against the specification/traces:
- initial_conditions / P1: instance resets with qRun = FALSE, so the first scan evaluates Run from a FALSE pre-state (no delayed extra scan).
- P2 (safety priority): Stop or open guard is evaluated first and forces Run FALSE in the same scan, overriding Start; loss of permissive also clears the latch because qRun is updated to FALSE.
- P3: Start with Stop FALSE and GuardClosed TRUE sets Run TRUE at the end of that same sampled scan.
- P4: with no Start and permissive present, Run := qRun (pure retention).
- P5: Run persists across invocations unless Stop or an open guard intervenes.
- Guard recovery: because the ELSE retention path has no edge/guard-closure condition, a Start still held on the scan where GuardClosed becomes TRUE takes the permitted-start branch and Run goes TRUE.

Fixed traces: latch test → FALSE, TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE; priority test → FALSE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE. Both match the expected values.

Status: compiled successfully; no PLC functional (online) tests were executed — compilation/offline only.
